```{=html}
<script>
// Warm the splicer app's WebAssembly runtime when a visitor shows intent to
// open it.
//
// The splicer runs R in the browser, so webR must download ~32 MB (R.wasm +
// library.data.gz) before the app draws its first pixel. That cost cannot be
// removed: even an empty Shinylive app pays it, and the vfs tree webR unpacks
// cannot be slimmed — it mounts every filesystem image eagerly and dies on
// startup with "Can't download Emscripten filesystem image metadata" if even
// one is absent (tested; see software/build-shinylive.R).
//
// What the download CAN be is moved earlier. Starting it on hover/focus buys
// the second or two before the click, so the app opens against a warm HTTP
// cache instead of a cold one.
//
// Deliberately not a <link rel="prefetch"> in the page head: that would push
// 32 MB at every visitor to this page, including everyone who never opens the
// splicer and everyone on metered mobile data.
(function () {
  var started = false;

  function warm(link) {
    if (started) return;
    started = true;
    var base = link.href.replace(/index\.html$/, "");
    ["shinylive/webr/R.wasm", "shinylive/webr/library.data.gz"].forEach(function (f) {
      // The body has to be consumed or the browser may never finish the
      // transfer, which would defeat the whole point.
      fetch(base + f, { priority: "low" })
        .then(function (r) { return r.blob(); })
        .catch(function () {});
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var links = document.querySelectorAll("a[href*='splicer-app']");
    if (!links.length) return;

    // Respect Data Saver and slow connections — on a 2G phone this would
    // compete with the page the visitor is actually trying to read.
    var c = navigator.connection;
    if (c && (c.saveData || /(^|-)2g$/.test(c.effectiveType || ""))) return;

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(links, function (link) {
      ["mouseenter", "focus", "touchstart"].forEach(function (ev) {
        link.addEventListener(ev, function () { warm(link); },
                              { once: true, passive: true });
      });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
